azure.message: The Azure CLI marks more than one entry as its default: tenant 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111 as an account whose name is not shown here (it is longer than this display allows, or shaped like a credential) (AzureCloud); tenant 11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111 as an account whose name is not shown here (it is longer than this display allows, or shaped like a credential) (AzureCloud). The product does not pick one.
azure.next_step: Make exactly one the default with: az account set --subscription SUBSCRIPTION (the subscription id or name), or sign out the others with: az logout --username NAME (the account name to sign out); then run this command again.

output.note: A signed-in account does not establish Graph, Intune or state-storage access; those stay unknown until a read actually succeeds.
